accordion.ingredientsContent:
French milled T55 flour, 84% fat farm butter, Levain live sourdough, spring water, cane sugar, sea salt.

Contains gluten and dairy. Free from preservatives, artificial additives, and palm oil.
accordion.servingContent:
For the crispest golden crust, warm in a preheated oven at 170°C (340°F) for 2-3 minutes. We advise against microwave reheating to preserve flaky pastry layers.

Store in our kraft paper bag in a cool, dry place for up to 24 hours.
accordion.deliveryContent:
• Free in-store bakery pickup daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
• Fast courier delivery within 45 minutes in insulated bags to keep items warm and crisp.

about.title: Monsieur Croissant Bakery
about.subtitle: The art of French pastry and natural sourdough baking
about.storyP1: Monsieur Croissant is an artisanal craft bakery founded with a passion for traditional French baking. We never use artificial additives, preservatives, or frozen dough.
about.storyP2: Every product is the result of long cold fermentation, living sourdough culture, and 82.5% farm butter. From the golden crust of a baguette to the delicate layers of a croissant, we strive for perfection in every bite.

values.craftDesc: Handcrafted daily using authentic slow proofing and laminating techniques.
values.naturalDesc: Only selected flour, water, sea salt, living sourdough, and pure butter.
values.freshDesc: Baking starts at 5 AM so that warm and fragrant pastries are ready for breakfast.
